documents.verified_scope: Default http.agent is built from VM/version and Build fields; release builds may include MODEL. Current master grammar is not proof of historical OEM defaults.
System properties can be set by the application. A Dalvik-looking string does not demonstrate an unmodified default.
Renderer/vendor expose driver descriptions when extension is exposed; privacy masking is permitted. These strings do not certify a physical GPU or rendering path.

documents.verified_scope: SwiftShader uses CPU rendering; GLES driver and WebGL fallback are separate modes. Automatic fallback deprecation does not mean software rendering is an attack.

documents.verified_scope: ANGLE is a translation layer with multiple backends. The ANGLE token alone cannot identify a Windows host or imply spoofing.
Host GPU, software, lavapipe, swiftshader and swangle paths are legitimate emulator rendering options. No current fingerprint string alone attests the host/physical rendering boundary.
DevTools supports UA overrides for development. An exposed UA value alone cannot determine authorization or default provenance.

documents.document_version: Current API reference; exact revision UNKNOWN
documents.verified_scope: Collector displayMetrics width/height describe an application display context. They are not proof of physical-panel dimensions; window/zoom differences remain legitimate.
The available logical-processor count can be limited by the user agent. Cross-container equality is not normative; probe zero is a fallback.
The value is approximate, quantized and bounded by the implementation; it is not exact native RAM or a permanent 8-GiB ceiling.
